This is to create 100% human hair with Janet Collection's latest new tech-feber. Which makes the product its best look, function, versatility, luster and bounciness.
STYLING & CARE
 Air-dry the hair whenever possible otherwise use a diffuser. Avoid pulling the hair while it's wet.  At night dry the hair completely before going to bed. To prevent tangling use sleeping cap.  Flat or curling irons can be used with temperature under 200ºF  Shake out curly styles; use a wide-tooth comb or fingers to loosen wavy hair
